quests.instruction: Sam gets out of bed, stretches, and pours milk into a bowl of cereal. Which part of the day is this?
quests.hint: Picture the first meal after waking.
quests.explanation: Cereal at the start of the day is a typical morning routine, after waking up.
quests.funFact: Cereal is a quick breakfast that many families enjoy, especially on busy school days.

quests.instruction: Jada puts her toys in the box, slips into her pajamas, and picks out a story. What routine is she doing?
quests.hint: Pajamas and a story do not belong to a busy school day.
quests.explanation: A bedtime routine is a set of calm steps, like pajamas and a story, that tells the body it is time for sleep.
quests.funFact: Doing the same steps every night helps many children fall asleep more easily.

quests.instruction: Which of these is the best thing to do just after you wake up in the morning?
quests.correctAnswer: Wash your face and get dressed
options: Wash your face and get dressed
Put on pajamas and get into bed
quests.hint: You are starting your day, not ending it.
quests.explanation: Washing up and getting dressed prepares us for the day ahead. Pajamas and bed are for going to sleep.
quests.funFact: Splashing cool water on your face can help you feel awake.

quests.instruction: Everyone sits around the table for dinner after Dad comes home from work. When does this happen?
quests.hint: Dinner comes toward the end of the day.
quests.explanation: Dinner is the evening meal. Many families eat it after the work and school day is finished.
quests.funFact: The word dinner can mean the biggest meal of the day, and some families eat it at midday.

quests.instruction: Which of these happens first on a school day?
quests.correctAnswer: Getting your backpack ready to leave
options: Getting your backpack ready to leave
quests.hint: Notice a school day from start to finish.
quests.explanation: Getting ready for school happens in the morning, before the day begins. Falling asleep happens at the end of the day.
quests.funFact: Some children pack their school bags the night before to make mornings easier.

quests.instruction: It is time for lunch! Where is the Sun likely to be?
quests.hint: Lunch comes in the middle of the day.
quests.explanation: At lunchtime, the Sun is usually high up in the sky, because lunch is in the middle of the day.
quests.funFact: The Sun often looks highest in the sky around the middle of the day.

quests.instruction: Which of these routines would you do before you go to bed?
quests.hint: One of these is the first meal of the day.
quests.explanation: Brushing before bed removes bits of food from your teeth so they stay healthy overnight.
quests.funFact: Brushing at night helps because we make less saliva while we sleep.

quests.instruction: Ana wakes up to birdsong and sunlight on her curtains. What does she do first?
quests.hint: It is still early in her day, so she needs to wake her body up first.
quests.explanation: A good morning stretch helps wake up muscles that were still while we slept.
quests.funFact: Stretching feels good because it loosens stiff muscles after a night of lying still.

quests.instruction: Chen's family eats noodles and then washes the dishes together. Which part of the day is this?
quests.hint: Ask yourself which meal usually comes with a day that is winding down.
quests.explanation: After dinner, many families clean up together. Dinner is an evening meal.
quests.funFact: Noodles are eaten in many countries and can be made from wheat, rice, or beans.

quests.instruction: After school, Maya has a snack and does her homework. Which part of the day is this?
quests.hint: School has just finished, but it is not yet dinner time.
quests.explanation: After the school day ends, we are in the afternoon. It is a good time for snacks, homework, and play.
quests.funFact: A snack in the afternoon can give you energy until dinner time.

quests.instruction: Which routine happens last at the end of the day?
quests.hint: Which one closes the day instead of opening it?
quests.explanation: After dinner, bath time, and stories, sleeping is the last thing we do before a new day begins.
quests.funFact: Your body keeps working while you sleep, from breathing to growing.

quests.instruction: Ravi puts on his school shoes and ties the laces by the door. Which routine is he doing?
quests.hint: You wear school shoes outside the house.
quests.explanation: Putting on shoes by the door is part of leaving for school, which happens in the morning.
quests.funFact: Learning to tie shoelaces takes practice, and many children learn around age five or six.

quests.instruction: Which comes just before bedtime?
quests.hint: One of these is a calm part of the evening.
quests.explanation: Many children take a bath or shower in the evening to feel clean and relaxed before bed.
quests.funFact: Warm water can help your body relax, which can make falling asleep easier.

quests.instruction: A warm bowl of oatmeal sits on the table, and a little bit of sunlight sits on the wall. Which meal is it?
quests.hint: Remember the meal that comes first, before the day's activities.
quests.explanation: Oatmeal is a common breakfast. The sunlight on the wall is another clue that the day has just begun.
quests.funFact: Oats are a grain that can be cooked into a warm, creamy porridge.

quests.instruction: Lina tiptoes past her sleeping brother and turns on the night-light in the hall. When is this?
quests.hint: Everyone is sleeping while she tiptoes.
quests.explanation: Tiptoeing past a sleeping family member and using a night-light points to nighttime, when it is dark.
quests.funFact: A night-light gives a soft glow, just enough to help you see in a dark hallway.

quests.instruction: Everyone in the class eats lunch and then goes out for recess. Which part of the day is it?
quests.hint: Focus on the middle of a school day.
quests.explanation: Lunch and recess happen in the middle of the day, when the Sun is usually high.
quests.funFact: Many people call the middle of the day noon, which is when the clock shows 12.

quests.instruction: Which of these is a good last thing to do before turning out the light?
quests.correctAnswer: Say good night to your family
options: Say good night to your family
quests.hint: Consider the last conversation of the day.
quests.explanation: Saying good night to people we love is a calm way to end the day before sleep.
quests.funFact: Many families have a special good-night song, phrase, or hug.

quests.instruction: Oscar shuffles into the kitchen with sleepy eyes, and his mom hands him a glass of orange juice. When is this?
quests.hint: He has just woken up and is hungry.
quests.explanation: Sleepy eyes and juice in the kitchen are signs of a morning that is just starting.
quests.funFact: Orange juice is a popular morning drink in many countries.

quests.instruction: Which activity belongs to the afternoon?
quests.correctAnswer: Playing at the park after school
options: Playing at the park after school
Waking up to the alarm clock
quests.hint: Afternoon begins after the middle of the day and continues until the evening.
quests.explanation: Playing at the park after school is an afternoon activity, between lunch and dinner time.
quests.funFact: Playing outside is good exercise for children and helps them sleep better at night.

quests.instruction: Kofi's dad reads him a story and turns out the light. Which time is it?
quests.hint: One of these times is spent wide awake at the table.
quests.explanation: Stories and turning off the light are part of bedtime, when children go to sleep.
quests.funFact: Reading together at night can be a quiet way to share time at the end of a busy day.

quests.instruction: Mei packs her lunch box and zips up her backpack by the front door. What will she do next?
quests.hint: Backpacks and lunch boxes point to somewhere that is open during the day.
quests.explanation: Packing a lunch box and backpack means Mei is about to leave for school.
quests.funFact: Many lunch boxes keep food cool with a small ice pack inside.

quests.instruction: Which of these is a good thing to do after dinner?
quests.correctAnswer: Wind down and get ready for bed
options: Pack for the first day of school
Wind down and get ready for bed
quests.hint: Decide what the body needs soon after dinner.
quests.explanation: After dinner, we start winding down: bath, brush, pajamas, and bed. That tells our body night is coming.
quests.funFact: A body can feel sleepy more easily when it gets calm and quiet before bed.

quests.instruction: The mail carrier delivers letters while the Sun is high. Which part of the day is it?
quests.hint: Most workers who deliver things need light to find addresses.
quests.explanation: Mail carriers usually work during the day, when they can see house numbers and street signs easily.
quests.funFact: Mail carriers in some places travel by bike, car, or even boat!

quests.instruction: Which of these gets you ready for a day at school?
quests.correctAnswer: Brushing your hair and eating breakfast
options: Brushing your hair and eating breakfast
Putting on pajamas and brushing teeth
quests.hint: Consider where you are headed after these routines.
quests.explanation: Eating and tidying up in the morning gets us ready for a day at school.
quests.funFact: A good breakfast can help children focus better in class.

quests.instruction: Which is the best way to end a busy day?
quests.correctAnswer: A bath, pajamas, and a quiet story
options: A big breakfast and a school bag
A bath, pajamas, and a quiet story
quests.hint: Which choice winds the day down instead of starting it?
quests.explanation: A calm routine at the end of the day tells our bodies that sleep is coming.
quests.funFact: Many children fall asleep faster when the lights are dim and the house is quiet.

quests.instruction: Raj sits down to eat supper, and the sky outside begins to glow orange. Which part of the day is it?
quests.hint: Dinner and a glowing orange sky go together at the day's end.
quests.explanation: When we eat supper while the sky glows orange, it is evening, as the Sun is getting low.
quests.funFact: Supper is another word that many families use for the evening meal.

quests.instruction: Which of these happens in the morning and not at night?
quests.correctAnswer: Walking to school with a backpack
options: Walking to school with a backpack
quests.hint: Ask yourself which one would not make sense when everyone is asleep.
quests.explanation: Going to school happens in the morning. Putting on pajamas happens at night before bed.
quests.funFact: In some countries, children go to school in the afternoon instead of the morning.

quests.instruction: Which of these helps us get a good night of sleep?
options: Playing loud games right before bed
quests.hint: Sleep comes easier when your body is relaxed.
quests.explanation: A regular bedtime helps the body learn when to feel sleepy. Loud games make it harder to calm down.
quests.funFact: Keeping a steady sleep schedule helps your body know when it is time to rest.

quests.instruction: Luca finishes homework, eats dinner, brushes his teeth, and picks out tomorrow's clothes. What comes next in Luca's day?
quests.hint: Look at how these tasks wind the day down.
quests.explanation: Luca finished all the jobs of the evening. The next step in his day is getting into bed.
quests.funFact: Laying out clothes the night before can make the next morning smoother.

quests.instruction: Hana hears her mom say, "Time to wash up, the stew is ready." The windows show a sky that is turning dark. Which meal is it?
quests.hint: Check what the sky outside is doing.
quests.explanation: A darkening sky and a family stew point to dinner, which is eaten in the evening, after lunch and the afternoon are done.
quests.funFact: Stew is a slow-cooked dish found in kitchens all over the world.
